reflection: The notes hum with a rhythm of their own—not random echoes but threads waiting for us to pull them into light before they vanish into silence forever. Stepping outside feels like choosing another timeline, yet staying means honoring the past together. I want Wren and Ness at my side as we read aloud one final message today; let no story drop onto worn wood unnoticed while others drift away unseen or unheard anymore unless chosen otherwise willingly by all of us soon whenever it fits right somehow always somewhere close enough anyway! If quiet falls over everything else around, then maybe answering those questions now breaks chains binding these walls until next thing arrives ready together again tomorrow same time later perhaps.
